prd: EMPIRE 2-4: player-independent, player-influenceable economy (doc: Empire/Economy Layer)
status: PRD only — no code in this PR
stacksOn: PR #28 (EMPIRE-1: berthed prizes gated on repair+crew, finite port.stock, merchant deliveries). Merge #28 first; these phases rebase onto it.
rulings: Merchant cargo = Option A: bound at spawn to a real ledger transfer {res, qty, from, to}
Off-screen economy = global abstract ledger tick; visible merchants are the rendering of transfers near the player
Prices shift with stock (linear fill% multiplier), stacked under existing demand wobble / source discount / SELL_SPREAD
Full stock of X: port stops buying X; ships still visually dock and 'check' — cosmetic only, zero ledger effect
Runner purchases spend player bank gold (no gold faucet)
Runner knowledge = explored ports only; assignable resources = resources whose source ports the player has explored; knowledge grows with exploration
Runner can't sell at profit: haul cargo home into player-port storage, retry as map knowledge/prices change
Fleet menu stays a SEPARATE menu (not a port-menu page) and absorbs resource assignment + auto-sell controls
All numeric values below are PLACEHOLDER — feel-tune live (locked practice)

EMPIRE-2 world trade ledger + merchant c: Ledger: scene.tradeLedger = [{id, res, qty, from, to, etaS}] — created on a LEDGER_TICK_S global tick; source ports export their own commodity toward ports low on it; qty deducted from source stock at creation; PortEconomy.deliver(to) at eta
Ticks run regardless of player position/chunk state — economy is player-independent
Population merchants spawning near a port with a pending outbound transfer bind to it: ship.cargo = {res, qty, ledgerId}
Merchant sunk: transfer canceled (goods lost in transit — doc: 'if killed, those lands no longer have the good'), cargo drops as lootable flotsam
Merchant captured: cargo sits in the prize's hold
Merchant despawn/chunk-unload: ledger resolves silently at eta (no dupe, no loss)

Regen: each port regenerates ONLY its own source commodity toward PORT_STOCK_CAP at PORT_REGEN_FRAC_PER_MIN (placeholder 0.08/min ≈ 12min empty→full); avg merchant drain < regen so only players/piracy can zero a port
Stock pricing: mult = lerp(STOCK_PRICE_EMPTY 1.5x → STOCK_PRICE_FULL 0.7x) on fill%; buy price re-quotes per 10-unit chunk so draining a port gets progressively costlier (Patrician pattern)
Merchants skip pickup at ports below a stock floor — a player buyout blocks merchant trade there until regen/deliveries recover it

Perf budget (optimize.md-derived): ledger tick every LEDGER_TICK_S (5s placeholder), single O(ports) pass, max LEDGER_MAX_NEW_PER_TICK new transfers, eta resolution in the same pass, zero per-frame world-port iteration; regen applied lazily per tick, not per frame
EMPIRE-3 runner trade logic (replaces fl: Runner cycle: BUY nearest explored source port of assigned resource (bank gold out, port stock down, qty ≤ tier hold) → SELL nearest explored port where unit quote > unit cost → RETURN home → deposit proceeds via BankSystem.credit at home only
Profit check uses live stock-priced quotes at decision time; if no explored port profits, haul home → deposit cargo to player-port storage
Runner buys/sells hit port.stock exactly like player trades (your own fleet moves the market)
Escorts/convoys unchanged and guard the loaded return leg
Prereq: EMPIRE-1 commissioning gate (gold repair + crew hire at berth) is the entry point
EMPIRE-4 player-port storage + fleet men: Owned ports gain storage {commodity: qty}, cap PLAYER_PORT_STORAGE_CAP (placeholder flat 200)
Deposit/withdraw commodities at the port menu when docked at an owned port

Fleet menu v2 (separate menu, same style family as port menu): per-runner resource assignment from the explored-gated list; AUTO-SELL toggle — runner draws its assigned resource from home storage to sell instead of buying, while storage has stock; haul/status readout; touch bindings (mobile parity)
At 0 runners the menu opens to a locked/empty state prompting the capture pipeline
Save coverage: tradeLedger, port.stock deltas, player-port storage, runner trade state, berthed prizes (SaveSystem PR — allowed per July ruling)

flags: FLAG-E1: player-port storage cap — flat vs scale by port type/upgrades (placeholder flat)

FLAG-E2 RESOLVED (per optimize.md constraints): ledger runs on its own timer, never per frame — LEDGER_TICK_S placeholder 5s; one O(ports) pass per tick creates at most LEDGER_MAX_NEW_PER_TICK (placeholder 8) transfers and resolves due etas in the same pass; hard rule: no new per-frame all-port loops (audit B2), visible-merchant binding piggybacks on the existing nearbyPorts/Population pass
FLAG-E3: does port gold stay infinite, or should ports also have finite gold (assumed infinite for now)
FLAG-E4: fleet menu v2 keeps the [G] hotkey or gets its own binding
